radiology_report:
Bravis Ziekenhuis
Department of Radiology
Date: 12 Dec 2024
Exam: mpMRI Prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 27.0 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+4, suspected extracapsular extension.
FINDINGS: Prostate volume 58.78 mL. PI-RADS 5 lesion in the peripheral zone, bilateral, measuring approximately 22 mm. Marked DWI restriction, ADC drop, and early DCE enhancement. Apparent extracapsular extension into periprostatic fat, consistent with cT3a.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 5, bilateral peripheral zone lesion, PSA density 0.459 ng/mL/mL, clinical stage cT3a. csPCa predicted probability 0.8667895.

previous_notes.author: Dr. T. Hendriks (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient presented with elevated PSA of 7.7 ng/mL. DRE was performed and a nodule was palpated. Referred to urology for further evaluation and biopsy.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (Jul 2023): Histology reveals adenocarcinoma with an acinar growth pattern, Gleason score 3+4, ISUP grade group 2. Perineural invasion is present. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, bilateral.
Biopsy 2 (Jan 2025): Histology reveals adenocarcinoma with an acinar growth pattern, Gleason score 3+4, ISUP grade group 2. Perineural invasion is present. No cribriform or intraductal patterns identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, bilateral.
Summary: The histological grade remains stable at Gleason 3+4 across both timepoints.
